name: Athlete’s Club
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5; Weight 3 lbs.; Price 18,300 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder of this +1 club gains a +4 bonus to Acrobatics skill checks and also gains the Endurance feat. One time per day, the wielder of this club may call upon the weapon’s power to gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution for 5 minutes.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, bear’s endurance; Cost 9,150 gp
